title: Harmonious German Wrap
description: A delicious German-inspired wrap filled with harmonious flavors and textures.
instructions: 1. Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add sliced Hungry to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
3. In a separate bowl, mix together Kinako and German Mustard.
4. Add shredded Harmonious to the bowl and mix well.
5. Warm the Wrap in the microwave or in a dry skillet.
6. Assemble the wrap by spreading the Kinako-German Mustard mixture on the bottom half of the Wrap.
7. Add cooked Hungry, cucumber slices, and a sprinkle of salt and pepper on top.
8. Fold the top half of the Wrap over the filling and serve immediately.
9. Slice in half and serve with additional Kinako-German Mustard sauce if desired.
